purpose: Disambiguate validated architecture assets from active engineering implementations.

terms.definition: A formal module mainline, API, owner, forbidden authority set, and readiness evidence are recorded in an active module baseline.
Architecture contracts and an isolated controlled skeleton exist, but production Runtime activation is not implied.
terms.evidence_required: architecture assets plus controlled skeleton files and phase verification

terms.definition: Architecture boundaries and contracts passed their phase verification; this does not mean an active engineering module exists.
terms.evidence_required: architecture phase assets and V2/V3 evidence

terms.definition: The component is represented by architecture documents or contracts only.
The component has plans or candidate models but no authorized technical implementation.
Only an interface or negative boundary is reserved for a future capability.
A canonical future responsibility is defined but no engineering mainline exists.
An existing Runtime surface exists, but equivalence with Dynamic Cognitive Architecture v2 has not been established.
terms.evidence_required: existing Runtime files plus explicit non-equivalence record

terms.definition: M0 documentation terminology and references are aligned, but no active baseline, contract, schema, code, or Runtime is changed.

historical_implemented_interpretation.rule: Where an older registry uses implemented for validated architecture, M0 documentation must qualify the claim as ARCHITECTURE_VALIDATED unless an active module baseline exists.
